title: Gas Leak Detection and Warning
tagline: Build an industrial air quality laboratory monitor that alerts you if hazardous gas is detected!

phases.instructions: Collect the MQ-9 Gas Sensor module, 1602 I2C LCD, Piezo Buzzer, and Red/Green status LEDs.
verificationCheckpoints: MQ-9 sensor with stainless steel mesh head ready

phases.instructions: Connect MQ-9 analog pin to Arduino A0. Connect 1602 LCD to I2C lines (A4/A5), and Buzzer to Digital Pin 8.
IMPORTANT: MQ gas sensors contain an internal micro-heating coil. The metal grill will get noticeably warm to the touch — this is normal operation! Do not touch metal mesh directly.
verificationCheckpoints: Ensure MQ-9 is elevated off flammable surfaces

phases.instructions: Examine how analog read values are mapped to air quality PPM safety zones and alert thresholds.
phases.codeExplanation:
- analogRead(MQ_PIN) measures resistance changes across the heated tin dioxide (SnO2) sensing element.
- Values below 300 represent clean ambient air.
- Values above 350 trigger the LCD DANGER warning and sound the alarm.
verificationCheckpoints: Understand how SnO2 resistance drops in presence of combustible gas

phases.instructions: Upload the code. Allow sensor 3 minutes to warm up. Simulate gas detection safely using an unlit butane lighter puff under adult supervision.
verificationCheckpoints: Simulated gas puff causes PPM to spike past 350 and sounds alarm

phases.instructions: Safety mission complete! You built a critical environmental monitor and mastered analog gas telemetry.
verificationCheckpoints: Ready to claim Safety Officer badge

story: Build a laboratory environmental safety sentinel! Construct an air quality monitor utilizing the MQ-9 gas sensor, 1602 LCD telemetry readout, and multi-stage audio/visual danger alarms.

troubleshooting.solution: This is completely normal and required for chemical reduction measurement. Keep away from bare skin.
diagnosticSteps: This is normal: MQ gas sensors have internal 5V heaters.
Wait 3 minutes for heater stabilization before testing gas.

troubleshooting.symptom: Alarm triggers immediately on power up
troubleshooting.cause: Sensor requires burn-in preheating period after being unpowered
troubleshooting.solution: Allow the sensor to run for 2-3 minutes until internal chemistry stabilizes.
diagnosticSteps: Allow 2-3 minutes preheat burn-in cycle in clean air.
Tune threshold potentiometer until alarm SILENCES in fresh air.
